title: Navier Partner Proposal
description: Partner-facing pitch document. WEB FOCUS: showcase the NEED for marine mobility, the JOURNEYS unlocked, the MULTIMODAL fit, and that we know their LOCAL use cases. Commercial model / unit economics live in the deck, NOT here. All v2 fields are optional and backward-compatible.

partner_context.description: OPEN WITH THEIR WORLD, not our product. Their ambition + the pressure they're under + where Navier slots in.

title.description: e.g. Grab x Navier - the black-car network, on the water

multimodal_fit.description: How Navier slots into the partner's EXISTING multimodal footprint (app/booking, last-mile, intermodal hubs). The water layer of a stack they already run.

journeys_unlocked.description: THE hero feature. Concrete local A->B journeys that prove we know their use cases: today's pain vs the Navier trip. Keep these vivid and specific.

today.description: how the journey is made today + the pain

differentiation.description: Light, web-appropriate. No economics. Answers 'why not a fast ferry / why not Candela'.

navier_moat.description: software-defined, autonomy-ready, Turkey factory, cap table, Maldives at-scale proof

proof_points.description: Sourced credibility. Every external number should carry evidence.

objections.description: FAQ: range, sea-state/weather, safety & first-of-class certification, charging infra, seasonality.

phases.description: An operating sequence, not a brochure. Each phase explains WHY this, WHY now, WHY this order.

cities.description: city_ids lit in this phase (MUST match map node feature IDs)

routes.description: route ids lit in this phase

route_scope.description: which routes to highlight for the phase cities

featured_routes.description: human-readable marquee routes for the side panel

timeline.description: e.g. 2026 H2 - the momentum cue (NOT financials)

rationale.description: why this phase sits here in the sequence

use_cases.description: local journey/use-case types proven in this phase

markets.description: OPTIONAL multi-market tabs (e.g. Uber: MENA / US / Global). When present, render shows market tabs; each market carries its own hero/why_now/journeys/phases/close. Top-level phases may stay as the default/first market.

the_ask.description: Division of labour + the concrete next step. Web-safe (no economics).
